SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: A personal savings goal owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

name.description: Display name of the savings goal (1 to 60 characters).

targetAmountCents.description: Target savings amount in minor currency units (cents), strictly greater than 0.

currentAmountCents.description: Current accumulated savings amount in cents, >= 0.

categoryIcon.description: Visual category icon key for the goal.

colorKey.description: Visual accent color key for the goal card.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SavingsTransaction.title: SavingsTransaction
SavingsTransaction.description: A deposit or withdrawal movement recorded against a user's savings goal.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

goalId.description: Document ID of the associated SavingsGoal under the same user.

goalName.description: Snapshot name of the associated savings goal at the time of the movement.

amountCents.description: Movement amount in cents, strictly greater than 0.

note.description: Optional short note describing the movement (0 to 120 characters).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/goals/{goalId}.description: Per-user collection of personal savings goals.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Per-user immutable ledger of savings deposits and withdrawals.
